prior: Isotropic Gaussian, standard deviation 1.625 in plot coordinates
target: Uniform density inside the original MIG roof outlines
inputs: x, y, time, eight sine/cosine time features and sixteen sine/cosine position features
time_sampling: Half uniform; half t=1-u^3 to emphasize final detail
objective: Mean squared error against x1-x0 at (1-t)*x0+t*x1
method: Independent endpoint conditional flow matching; learned velocity integrated with midpoint method
